#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a cover page PDF and a placeholder report body, then merge them."""
import os
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
DATE = "August 01, 2026"


def escape_pdf_text(s: str) -> str:
    return s.replace("\\", r"\\").replace("(", r"\(").replace(")", r"\)")


def build_pdf(path: str, lines, page_size=(612, 792), font_size=24):
    """Write a minimal valid single-page PDF containing the given text lines.

    lines: list of (text, y_from_top, font_size) tuples.
    """
    pw, ph = page_size
    objects = []
    content_parts = []
    for text, y_top, size in lines:
        content_parts.append(
            f"BT /F1 {size} Tf 72 {ph - y_top} Td ({escape_pdf_text(text)}) Tj ET"
        )
    content = "\n".join(content_parts).encode("latin-1")

    objects.append(b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>")
    objects.append(f"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>".encode("latin-1"))
    objects.append(
        (
            f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 {pw} {ph}] "
            f"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>"
        ).encode("latin-1")
    )
    objects.append(b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>")
    objects.append(
        b"<< /Length " + str(len(content)).encode() + b" >>\nstream\n" + content + b"\nendstream"
    )

    buf = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = []
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(buf))
        buf += b"%d 0 obj\n" % i
        buf += obj
        buf += b"\nendobj\n"

    xref_pos = len(buf)
    buf += b"xref\n0 %d\n" % (len(objects) + 1)
    buf += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets:
        buf += b"%010d 00000 n \n" % off
    buf += (
        b"trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n"
        % (len(objects) + 1, xref_pos)
    )

    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(bytes(buf))


def main():
    # Cover page: centered title and date
    build_pdf(
        "cover.pdf",
        [
            (TITLE, 320, 32),
            (DATE, 375, 18),
        ],
    )

    # If report.pdf does not exist, create a minimal placeholder body so the
    # requested file exists to attach the cover page to.
    if not os.path.exists("report.pdf"):
        build_pdf(
            "report_body.pdf",
            [
                ("Annual Financial Report", 60, 20),
                ("This is the body of the report.", 100, 12),
                ("Placeholder content - no original report.pdf was found.", 120, 12),
            ],
        )
        body_file = "report_body.pdf"
    else:
        body_file = "report.pdf"

    # Merge: cover page first, then the report body
    writer = PdfWriter()
    reader_cover = PdfReader("cover.pdf")
    for page in reader_cover.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    reader_body = PdfReader(body_file)
    for page in reader_body.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open("report.pdf", "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)

    print("Created report.pdf with cover page:")
    print("  Title:", TITLE)
    print("  Date:", DATE)
    print("  Total pages:", len(PdfReader("report.pdf").pages))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
